=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:5115-5164 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In release_gate_oldest_queued_wait, when total_count > 100 the helper fetches only the last page and takes candidates only from that page (`.[:$max_reads][]`), so when total_count is just over a multiple of 100 (for example 101 or 201) only 1 or 2 of the allowed 3 job reads happen and the older runs on the previous page are never read.
  WHY: If the one oldest run on the last page is a concurrency hold or has no queued job, the helper returns `outcome=short ... runs_unread=100` and auto_release_stable.sh:866 / promote_main_cycle.sh:2061 dispatch a gate cycle while runners are saturated. Severity differs: openai_gpt-6-luna says MAJOR, while anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash say NIT; this ledger uses the highest. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash notes the limitation predates the last run, and google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite raised the same issue as a hardening suggestion.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "The full test suite passes." (Acceptance criterion 4 of issue #10181)
  expected_change_site: The PR's pre-push test gate and acceptance results
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The PR description lists 30 inherited failures, including the whole file `tests/test_auto_release_stable.py`, which holds 4 of the 5 new runner-wait acceptance targets. The acceptance table marks five runner-wait targets `unmet`; only `tests/test_promote_main_cycle.py::test_runner_wait_held_run_replay_runs_the_cycle` is `met`. The gate output has no green run of the new tests in `tests/test_auto_release_stable.py`, and no passing full-suite result is shown. The failure is attributed to a missing PyYAML in the environment and also occurs on the merge-base. Severity differs: openai_gpt-6-luna says MAJOR, while anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite say NIT; the last two treat it as an environmental missing-verification gap or an accepted deferral. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash reported NONE and cited the deferral.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:release_gate_oldest_queued_wait, lines 5115-5132 and 5136-5142 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: When total_count > 100, `_rgw_json` is replaced by the last page only (`page=${_rgw_page}`) and candidates come only from that page. For 101 or 201 runs the last page holds 1 run, so 1 or 2 runs are read instead of 3. The new `_rgw_unread_extra` (lines 5124-5131) reports the gap in `runs_unread` but does not restore the coverage.
  WHY: If the oldest run on the last page is a concurrency hold or has no queued job, line 5180 skips it and the helper prints `outcome=short ... runs_unread=100`. auto_release_stable.sh:866 and promote_main_cycle.sh:2061 then log `outcome=clear` and dispatch while runners are saturated. Suggested fix: also fetch page `_rgw_page - 1`, merge the pages, increment calls, subtract that page's run count from `_rgw_unread_extra`, and update the docstring to `calls=<0..6>`.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "The full test suite passes." (Acceptance criterion 4 of issue #10181)
  Expected change site: The PR's pre-push test gate and acceptance results.
  Evidence of absence: 30 inherited failures, including the whole file `tests/test_auto_release_stable.py`, which holds 4 of the 5 new runner-wait targets. Five targets are `unmet`; only `tests/test_promote_main_cycle.py::test_runner_wait_held_run_replay_runs_the_cycle` is `met`. The failure comes from `import yaml` (PyYAML is missing) and also happens on the merge-base. No green run of the new tests exists. This is a missing-verification gap, not a code defect.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- HARDENING: scripts/gh_helpers.sh release_gate_oldest_queued_wait, last-page branch, lines 5115-5131. Fewer than 3 candidates are read when the last page holds 1-2 runs. Fix: when the page's `workflow_runs | length` is below `_rgw_max_job_reads` and `_rgw_page` > 1, fetch page `_rgw_page - 1` and merge with `jq -s '{workflow_runs: (.[0].workflow_runs + .[1].workflow_runs)}'`. Increment `_rgw_calls`, subtract that page's run count from `_rgw_unread_extra`, and update the docstring's calls range. Estimate: 8-10 lines. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "The full test suite passes."
  Expected change site: PR test-gate and acceptance results.
  Evidence of absence: 30 inherited failures, including `tests/test_auto_release_stable.py`, and five runner-wait targets are marked unmet. The author calls these environmental failures and verified that the tests pass with stubs, so this reviewer accepts the deferral.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- HARDENING: scripts/gh_helpers.sh release_gate_oldest_queued_wait, lines 5115-5131. When `total_count > 100`, only the last page is read. If it holds fewer than 3 runs, the previous page is not fetched for more candidates. Fix: fetch previous pages and merge them until the candidate count is met or the pages run out. Estimate: ~10 lines. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:5115-5120, 5136-5142, 5155-5164 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: When the queued-run count is just over a multiple of 100, the helper fetches only the short final page and takes candidates from it. For 101 runs it reads one job set instead of the three available.
  WHY: If the oldest run on page 2 has no jobs but the next-oldest run on page 1 has a queued job past the wait limit, that job is never read. The helper returns short and the release cycle starts despite a qualifying runner wait.

  Requirement: "The full test suite passes."
  Expected change site: The PR's test-gate and acceptance results.
  Evidence of absence: The PR description reports 30 inherited failures and shows no passing full-suite result, so the criterion remains unmet.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:release_gate_oldest_queued_wait, lines 5115-5142 (last-page-only listing retained; candidates taken only from that page via `.[:$max_reads][]` at line 5142) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: With 101 or 201 aged queued runs, the last page holds 1 run, so only 1 of the 3 allowed `_rgw_max_job_reads` happens while 100 older runs sit on the discarded page. The `_rgw_unread_extra` change (lines 5124-5131) surfaces the gap but does not restore coverage. Before this PR, the helper answered `long` (a conservative skip) in this case.
  WHY: If the oldest run is a concurrency hold, one job read gives `short` and the gate cycle dispatches; it can then time out on the same runner wait the check exists to prevent. The limitation predates the last run.
- TASK_GAP: NONE. The reviewer cites a deferral for "The full test suite passes": the 30 failures are inherited, the gate status is pass with 0 caused failures, CI failed_count is 0, and the new runner-wait tests passed in the 103-check re-run. No diff-level deliverable from issue #10181 is missing.
- HARDENING: scripts/gh_helpers.sh release_gate_oldest_queued_wait, last-page branch, lines 5115-5131. The last page can hold fewer than `_rgw_max_job_reads` runs, so older candidates stay unread while the read budget is unused. Fix: when `_rgw_page > 1` and the page length is below `_rgw_max_job_reads`, fetch page `_rgw_page - 1`, merge with `jq -s 'add'`, and subtract the extra page's run count from `_rgw_unread_extra`. Estimate: 8 lines. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
